checks: Parquet snapshot is labeled, provenance-bearing, idempotent and bounded
managed dataset and result snapshots survive deletion and original dependency invalidation
2 KiB scalar answer stays in one call with quality intact and guarded typed access
keyed diff counts additions, removals and per-field changes with bounded examples
duplicate and null keys block comparison; schema changes remain separate from value changes
reusable SQL assertions retain exact violation counts and bounded evidence; SQL failure cannot pass
partial coverage cannot pass checks, diffs or independent snapshot admission
recipe replaces inputs and typed parameters with independent durable run and step records
failed assertions stop later steps; SQL failure keeps accepted IDs and invalid DAGs fail before work
branch package includes dependency SQL, parameters, identity, quality, notes, report and result payloads
offline byte verification and fresh-workspace import support follow-ups without original files or SQL execution
included inputs yield an inert recipe that recomputes only on explicit run
tampering, traversal, symlink payloads, byte exhaustion and overwrite attempts are rejected
incomplete packages retain failure context and cannot be imported
import checks recorded schema and row count against actual payloads and reports completed copies on failure
imported managed copies survive removal of delivered Parquet payloads
